name: Kinetix Ai
summary:
Kinetix AI develops embodied intelligence with a focus on highly anthropomorphic robots. Founded in July 2025, it works across robot hardware, cognition, dexterous manipulation and data infrastructure. Its portfolio includes the KaiBot humanoid platform and KAI Hand, alongside tools for gathering human-centered training data.

KAI Halo Lite and the KAI EGO Dataset form part of this data pipeline, while SMASH is used to test capabilities. The company aims to connect human-like physical design with learning methods grounded in real-world activity. This combines development of complete robots with the hands, models and training resources needed to improve their physical interaction skills.
